subject: general
question: The New Moore Island is in geographic proximity to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• New Moore Island, also known as South Talpatti, is a small uninhabited island located in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The island is situated near the estuary of the Hariabhanga river, which forms part of the border between India and Bangladesh.
 
• New Moore Island emerged as a result of the deposition of sediments carried by the river and oceanic processes.
 
• The island has been a subject of territorial disputes between India and Bangladesh, but it disappeared due to rising sea levels in 2010.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographic Proximity and Territorial Disputes**

 
 
• Geographic proximity refers to the closeness of one geographic location to another. In this case, New Moore Island is geographically close to the coast of Bangladesh.
 
• Territorial disputes are common between nations that share borders, particularly over regions with strategic or economic importance. The New Moore Island dispute was one such case.
 
 
 
• **Hariabhanga River**
 
 
• The Hariabhanga River is a transboundary river that flows between India and Bangladesh.
 
• It is one of the rivers that forms the Sundarbans delta, the largest tidal halophytic mangrove forest in the world.
 
 
 
• **Bay of Bengal**
 
 
• The Bay of Bengal is the northeastern part of the Indian Ocean, bounded by India on the west and northwest, Bangladesh on the north, and Myanmar on the east.
 
• It is the largest bay in the world, with significant economic and strategic importance for the surrounding countries.
 
 
 
• **Climate Change and Rising Sea Levels**
 
 
• Climate change has led to rising sea levels, which have resulted in the submergence of low-lying islands and coastal areas.
 
• New Moore Island was submerged due to rising sea levels, highlighting the impact of climate change on geographical and political landscapes.
